propositions: The ticket-type map _LOCAL_TO_JIRA_TYPE exists as two identical but independent dict literals in adapters/jira/outbound_fields.py:88 and adapters/jira_datacenter/backend.py:43, creating risk of silent divergence between Cloud and DC create paths.
The boundary guard that enforces single-sourcing for STATUS and PRIORITY maps does not cover the ticket-type map, allowing a third copy to be introduced without detection.

The ticket-type map must be relocated to adapters/jira_family/value_maps.py as the canonical definition and imported under the _LOCAL_TO_JIRA_TYPE alias in both create paths, following the J2 pattern for cross-adapter maps.

The module-level attribute _LOCAL_TO_JIRA_TYPE must remain resolvable on outbound_fields as a module attribute to avoid breaking the external consumer in test_outbound_differ_session_log_exclusion.py:87.
The boundary guard must be extended to detect any future literal of the ticket-type map under adapters/, failing the build if a second copy is introduced.
